data.title: Lodi Dottie
data.bio: Lodi Dottie is vinyl DJ + glass artist based in the Mojave Desert. She participates in ODR through her show, Looking Glass, and has spun records at venues throughout the hi desert, low desert, and LA.
data.showDescription: Looking Glass is best played loud. Summer heat, feet crunching desert sand, absorbing  soundscapes: embrace the wonder and tension.
